verdict.rationale: Docusign documents its own general capability to prepare agreements from reusable, shared templates and to send them for online signature and approval, which covers the core mechanics of executing board consents. Nothing in the evidence addresses board consents or resolutions specifically. missing for 10: board-consent/resolution-specific templates or drafting, board member roster and unanimous/majority approval tracking, minute-book or corporate-records integration, independent hands-on corroboration for board-governance use.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can prepare board consents and resolutions and collect approvals online
